people.name: Benaiah
people.line: Son of Jehoiada, a mighty warrior and loyal supporter of David and Solomon.

people.name: Cherethite
people.line: Member of Philistine tribe serving as royal guard

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jehoiada
people.line: Father of one of David's warriors, Benaiah

people.name: Pelethites
people.line: Elite military unit loyal to King David

translations.web: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites, and David’s sons were chief ministers.
translations.bsb: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and Pelethites; and David’s sons were priestly leaders.
translations.kjv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons were chief rulers.
translations.asv: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons were chief ministers.
